author: ReeceyRages99
body: I would like to start of with a sorry for the incident about the hacking. I will admit there was hacks on my computer and I also will admit my friend installed them although I thought this was funny I had to idea he intended to use them in multiplayer he just told me he used them in single player. Unfortunately I was banned and I wondered if there was anything you could do thanks ..  Further more I would appreciate it so much if you could help me out avicus itself said hackers get another chance!
